description: Re-run sponsor detection on a YouTuber already in the database (latest videos). Costs 50 requests of your monthly MCP quota. Refused when the channel was analyzed less than 7 days ago — every channel is re-scanned weekly, so check lastAnalyzedAt from youtuber_get first. Runs in the background (a few minutes); call youtuber_get / youtuber_sponsors afterwards. For a channel not in the database yet, use youtuber_add.
name: youtuber_refresh
